entries.anchor: University of Toledo · Data Science & Statistics
entries.fact: Emmanuel Atindama is now an Assistant Professor of Data Science and Statistics at the University of Toledo, a role he began in August 2024. The Sokol GxP Services role still on file is out of date.

entries.anchor: St. Lawrence University ’18 · Hermon-DeKalb Central Schools
entries.fact: Casey Ostler played field hockey at St. Lawrence University from 2014 to 2016 and graduated Phi Beta Kappa with the Class of 2018. She then worked at Hermon-DeKalb Central Schools from 2021 to 2024. Her record previously listed men’s cross country — that was wrong.
Isa Goettl played a season at the University of Minnesota (2023–24) before Bemidji State and Clarkson, earning WCHA All-Academic and CSC Academic All-District honors.
entries.name: sf:isa-goettl
